# Route matrix for the tuner parity diff. One request per line:
# <name> <printf-format of the raw request>. GET only (read-only on live).

health-query       GET /health?probe=1 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n
root-query         GET /?a=1&b=2 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n

nope               GET /nope HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n
health-upper       GET /HEALTH HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n
